description:
There are over 7 billion people on this planet. And by 2050, there will be 2 billion more... many moving into urban centers at an unprecedented rate. Making sure there is enough food, fiber and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we're all about at John Deere. And it's why we're investing in our people and our technology like never before! Here the world's brightest minds are tackling the world's biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we'll put you to work. RIGHT NOW.
  
  John Deere is an equal opportunity employer, including disabled & veterans. 
   
 Primary Location: United States (US) - Illinois  - East Moline  
 Function: Technology (CA)
 Title: Software Engineer - 124423  
 Onsite/Remote: Onsite Position 
  
   
  
 Your Responsibilities 
 
  
 As a Software/Data Engineer on the John Deere Dealer Data Lake team at East Moline or Chicago, IL locations, you will contribute to the design, development, and support of enterprise-scale data and analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision making across dealer operations. You will work with large and complex datasets from John Deere dealer business systems and enterprise data sources while gaining hands-on experience with modern cloud data engineering technologies. 

 Key responsibilities include: 

 1. Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions. 
 2. Develop data models that support reporting, business intelligence, and advanced analytics use cases. 
 3. Build, deploy, support, and optimize data products for dealer analytics environments. 
 4. Collaborate with engineering teams to improve platform capabilities, scalability, reliability, and performance. 
 5. Participate in technical discussions involving architecture decisions, engineering best practices, and technical debt reduction initiatives. 
 6. Monitor and improve data quality, consistency, and reliability across distributed data environments. 
 7. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex data and analytics platform issues. 
 8. Support incident management activities by assisting in the resolution of data defects, outages, and production issues. 
 9. Partner with source system teams, analytics platform teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality data solutions. 
 10. Contribute to CI/CD automation and DevOps practices to improve deployment efficiency and solution quality. 
 11. Document technical solutions, data flows, and engineering processes. 
  
 VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position 


 What Skills You Need 
 
  
 Experience with Python programming for data engineering and automation. 
 Knowledge of Apache Spark for large-scale data processing and transformation. 
 Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or modern cloud-based data and analytics platforms. 
 Understanding of CI/CD concepts and automated deployment practices. 
 Experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for source control and deployment automation. 
 Knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts. 
 Understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and data integration principles. 
 Familiarity with data quality, validation, and monitoring techniques 
 Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics FO and CRM systems for dealers network systems    
 

 What Makes You Stand Out 
 
  
 Experience working with cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks. 
 Knowledge of data lake, lakehouse, and modern data architecture patterns. 
 Exposure to Power BI, reporting, and analytics solutions. 
 Familiarity with distributed computing and big data technologies. 
 Understanding of DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation principles. 
 Experience with REST APIs and data integration services. 
 Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data cataloging concepts. 
 Exposure to Agile software development methodologies and Scrum practices. 
 Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools. 
 Participation in academic projects, internships, hackathons, or open-source projects involving data engineering, analytics, or machine learning 
 

 Education 
 
 Ideally, you will have a degree or equivalent related work experience in the following: 
 •  Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer/software engineering or related degree. 



 What You'll Get 
 At John Deere, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. Here, you'll enjoy the freedom to explore new projects, the support to think outside the box and the advanced tools and technology that foster innovation and achievement. Additionally, we offer a comprehensive reward package to help you get started on your new career path, including:
 Flexible work arrangements
 Highly competitive base pay 
 Savings & Retirement benefits (401K and Defined Contribution)
 Healthcare benefits with a generous company contribution in the Health Savings Account
 Adoption assistance
 Employee Assistance Programs
 Tuition assistance
 Fitness subsidies and on-site gyms at specific Deere locations
 Charitable contribution match
 Employee Purchase Plan & numerous discount programs for personal use
 Vacation and Holiday Pay
  $86,892.00  - $130,332.00  + Benefits
 Follow this link to learn more about our Total Rewards Package  https://bit.ly/3XCd8fL  
 Must be 18 years of age or older to apply 

 The information contained herein is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and qualifications required of individuals performing the job. The qualifications detailed in this job description are not considered the minimum requirements necessary to perform the job, but rather as guidelines.
